Hiro: RCA posted for the cache warmup gap incident: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2387654321-cache-warmup-gap
Hiro: Short summary: during a model swap the new nodes were not primed with KV prefixes due to a timing bug in the priming orchestration. Resulted in a short cold-start window with elevated 5xx and latency for ~32m.
Hiro: Full doc includes timeline, priming logs, small repro harness, and anonymized request traces. Please review owners and the proposed mitigations.
Hiro: Proposed action items (owners + targets):
- Grace 	6: implement deterministic prefetch step in the deployer and add a unit test for race conditions 	6 target 2026-04-09
- Luca 	6: add a canary gating step that verifies >90% prefetch hit-rate before traffic shift 	6 target 2026-04-05
- Sana 	6: craft customer-facing note and update support detection steps (include sample query to spot cold-starts) 	6 target 2026-03-31
Hiro: I've also added a small rollback checklist and a short runbook entry for oncall to detect and throttle traffic during warmup.
Luca: I'll take the canary gate. Planning to add an automatic hold if prefetch hit-rate < 0.9 for 5m. Will open RFC + PR.
Grace: I'll build the deterministic prefetch and include a test harness that simulates overlapped priming requests. Will link PR to the doc.
Sana: I'll draft the comms and the support playbook snippet. Suggest adding a short note in status page if incidents cross 30m.
OncallBot: Incident created: INC-12045 	6 https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-12045
Luca: Quick ask 	6 can someone paste the observed prefetch hit-rate curve from the incident so I can reuse it in the canary spec?
Hiro: Pasted the curve and the trimmed logs in the doc. Note the 3-stage latency bump around 10:12 PT.
Grace: Opening PR #1517 with prefetch implementation and unit tests. Tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-sre for review.
Sana: Added a draft customer template and support checklist to the doc. Will update after PR lands.
Hiro: Scheduling a 30-min checkpoint Thursday 11:00 PT to review PR, canary parameters, and the support note: https://calendar.internal/meet/cache-warmup-check
Luca: +1
Grace: +1
Sana: +1 	6 will bring the comms draft.
Hiro: Thanks team. If you can't attend the checkpoint, please leave a short note in the doc with any blockers. :thumbsup:
